Refiner via a local llama.cpp CUDA build (b12132, CUDA 13.3, sm_86) -ngl 99 -p 16,64 -n 32 -r 5, 2 runs: tg32 449.26+-0.45 / 448.87+-0.65 t/s; pp16 3866.9+-451 / 3836.2+-509; pp64 10348.8 / 10342.0. method: metal_bench.m, MSL compiled at runtime, GPU timestamps, 10 reps per run. read = uint4 xor over 2 GiB private buffer; per-run medians 307.4/304.3/329.8/332.0/333.8/354.0 (6 runs), cell = largest; at the low end (304) the floor is 3.22 ms and decode is 73% of it.
